knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.intro: Read, connect and verify saved knowledge. Original documents remain in the Library.
knowledge.auto_refresh: List and current details update automatically every 2 seconds
knowledge.search_hint: Search titles, aliases or content, or browse saved pages.
knowledge.error: Operation not completed ({code}). Check the input or reload the record.
knowledge.broken_link: The object no longer exists or the link is invalid. Your previous reading is retained.
knowledge.choose_object: Choose a knowledge page on the left to start reading.
knowledge.choose_root: Choose an object, then select Center here.
knowledge.edge_required: Select at least one edge type.
knowledge.graph_scope: Bounded local connections only. Distance does not encode similarity, nor degree credibility. Dragging changes layout only.
knowledge.truncated: Results truncated: this is neither a complete neighborhood nor a whole-library count.
knowledge.no_evidence: No evidence yet; the assertion is not thereby verified.
knowledge.location_current: Quote matches the current source (not factual verification)
knowledge.location_changed: Source content changed; this does not make the assertion false
knowledge.location_missing: Original document or chunk missing; quote snapshot retained
knowledge.location_unresolved: Other library is not connected; local IDs cannot resolve it
knowledge.source_unavailable: The current source cannot be located. The quote snapshot remains available.
knowledge.target_limit: Up to 50 candidates. Check type, summary and ID for duplicate names; narrow the query if needed.
knowledge.choose_target: Search and select a target object.
knowledge.evidence_hint: Piece sources require library, document and chunk IDs; local quotes are checked. External sources need a title and URL. User explanations do not create source links.
knowledge.conflict_draft: This content has changed. Your draft is retained; compare it with the latest version below.
knowledge.compare_then_save: Latest version loaded. Review the differences before saving again.
knowledge.uncertain: Response not confirmed. Original request key {request_key} and submitted content are retained. Save again to query it first. Edited fields will not replace that request.
knowledge.delete_scope: Confirmation follows the previewed scope; changed scope requires a new preview. Original files and backups are not touched.
knowledge.delete_conflict: Deletion not completed ({code}). Cancel, reload and preview again; stale confirmation will not be used.
knowledge.history_readonly: Read-only history. To restore old text, create a new revision against the latest revision; never rewrite history.
knowledge.review_intro: Read-only structural checks, not semantic judgment or automatic repair. Duplicate names and isolated objects are informational.
knowledge.filtered: Current result page on the left
knowledge.lint_ISOLATED_OBJECT: Isolated object: no explicit connections; not necessarily a problem.
knowledge.lint_BROKEN_BODY_LINK: An internal link points to a missing object.
knowledge.lint_UNREGISTERED_BODY_LINK: An internal content link is not registered as a page link.
knowledge.lint_LINK_NOT_IN_BODY: An explicit page link is not present in the content.
knowledge.lint_RELATION_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE: Relation has no supporting, opposing or contextual evidence.
knowledge.lint_SOURCE_CHANGED: Source content differs from the saved version.
knowledge.lint_SOURCE_MISSING: The referenced original file or chunk does not exist.
knowledge.lint_AMBIGUOUS_NAME: Duplicate name / alias candidates indicate ambiguity, not an automatic merge recommendation.
knowledge.saved_unread: Committed, but the target could not be read back; another caller may have deleted it. Check the returned ID rather than creating a duplicate.
knowledge.partial_saved: Committed, but {count} item(s) did not finish; index status: {index}. Check the returned IDs.
knowledge.lint_WIKI_BROKEN_LINK: A Wiki internal link points to a missing page.
knowledge.lint_WIKI_ORPHAN_PAGE: Page has no incoming links; may be unreferenced (informational).
knowledge.delete_retains_history: Online revision history is retained and remains readable after deletion.
knowledge.delete_clears_history: Clears this record's own online revision history.
knowledge.delete_local_recovery: The replaced Markdown is kept as a local recovery copy (.wiki-recovery-*.bak); this is not complete erasure.

settings_embedding.test_dim_mismatch: Dimension mismatch! Actual dimension: {actual}, configured dimension: {expected}

settings_performance.title: Indexing Performance
settings_performance.hint: Set request limits and concurrency to match your embedding provider's quota.
settings_performance.restart_hint: Restart Piece for changes to take effect.
settings_performance.tpm_tooltip: Set to about 80% of your provider's TPM quota. SiliconFlow (verified) allows 500,000, hence the 400,000 default.
settings_performance.rpm_tooltip: Maximum embedding requests per minute; keep it below your provider's RPM quota.
settings_performance.concurrency_tooltip: Number of in-flight embedding requests. Higher is faster but risks 429 rate limits.
settings_performance.batch_size_tooltip: Chunks packed into one embedding request. Lower it when chunks are large to stay under the per-request token limit.
settings_performance.worker_concurrency_tooltip: Files the worker indexes at the same time; helps most with bulk imports.

settings_mcp.title: MCP Service Settings
settings_mcp.retrieval_port_hint: Retrieval MCP service port (requires application restart to take effect after modification)
settings_mcp.index_port_hint: Defaults to retrieval port +1; PIECE_INDEX_MCP_PORT can override it (display only)
settings_mcp.key_hint: For read-only access, share only the retrieval service and its key. Existing configs keep the shared key; regenerate keys separately to split permissions. Save, quit Piece from the tray and restart, then update the corresponding client config.
settings_mcp.key_regenerated: New key generated; save and restart Piece to apply
settings_mcp.auth_enabled_hint: When disabled, anyone can access MCP service (only recommended for local debugging)
settings_mcp.include_images_hint: When enabled, the AI also receives the figures embedded in the retrieved cards (only for documents that have them; costs extra tokens). The AI can still skip them when not needed.

settings_storage.title: Data Storage Settings
settings_storage.data_path_hint: Root directory for storing database, original files and working files (requires application restart to take effect after modification)

settings_webdav.title: Cloud Sync Settings
settings_webdav.hostname_hint: Nutstore: Create a folder (e.g. Piece) in web, then use full path https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/Piece/
settings_webdav.password_hint: Nutstore requires app password (create in Account Settings → Security → Third-party Apps)

settings_ocr.title: PDF Parsing Settings
settings_ocr.base_url_hint: Pre-filled with the official cloud service; replace it with a self-hosted address. Leave empty to parse PDFs locally with PyMuPDF.
settings_ocr.api_key_help: No API key? Get one from Baidu AI Studio
settings_ocr.hint: When configured, all PDFs are parsed via the OCR service (supports scanned documents and layout recovery). Images are saved next to the working file.
settings_ocr.vlm_base_url_hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint including the version prefix, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1. Leave empty to parse PDFs locally with PyMuPDF.
settings_ocr.vlm_model_hint: Must be a multimodal model that accepts image input; text-only models cannot read pages.
settings_ocr.vlm_hint: When configured, each PDF page is rendered to an image and transcribed to Markdown by the model (supports scanned documents). No images are extracted; figures are replaced by text descriptions. Higher DPI is clearer but costs more tokens; concurrency is bounded by your provider's rate limits.
settings_ocr.mineru_token_help: No token? Register at mineru.net to get one
settings_ocr.mineru_model_version_hint: vlm gives better layout recovery and formula recognition; pipeline is faster and will not invent content that is not in the document.
settings_ocr.mineru_language_hint: Affects the OCR stage only; keep ch for mixed Chinese/English. Use the language-family packs (latin, arabic, ...) for scripts that share one model.
settings_ocr.mineru_is_ocr_hint: Try enabling this if text cannot be extracted from a scan.
settings_ocr.mineru_hint: Supports scans, tables and formulas; figures are saved with the parsed content. Documents over 200MB or 200 pages are parsed in batches.
settings_ocr.third_party_warning: The full document is uploaded to mineru.net. Make sure it is safe to share.
settings_ocr.payload_hint: Unwarping/orientation suit photos or skewed scans; keep "Service default" for normal PDFs to stay fast. Ignored layout labels drop repeated headers/footers (e.g. header,footer). Advanced parameters can be set via CLI: piece config update ocr.payload.extra_payload.

settings_office.title: Office Documents
settings_office.converter_hint: Convert Word/PPT to PDF to retain formulas and layout, then use the PDF parsing settings. Auto prefers Microsoft Office, then LibreOffice. When off or unavailable, files are parsed directly. Excel is unaffected.
settings_office.libreoffice_path_hint: Path to the soffice executable; leave empty to auto-detect. On Windows point to soffice.com (soffice.exe cannot be waited on synchronously).
settings_office.test_none: No conversion backend available; Word/PPT will use the original parser

graph.intro: Maintain entities, semantic relations and evidence independently; graph nodes have no Wiki body.

graph.rebuild_intro: Rebuild the query index from existing entities, relations and evidence only; it never rewrites knowledge or history and never calls models.
